scope: C07/C08 shared reminder rules, dispatch gate and native capability boundary
limitations: No Android device, Room database, notification permission, AlarmManager/WorkManager, reboot or force-stop verification was performed.

Electron SQLite and a dependency-injected desktop notification adapter have local static/synthetic evidence only; no encryption key storage, toast/planned-task, sleep, exit or restart verification was performed.
The shared ledger and DST tests do not prove background delivery, system delivery, user-visible receipt, or cross-device exactly-once behavior.
The Node 24 SQLite preflight is independent of Electron and does not prove production storage compatibility or native scheduling.
The existing web timer remains process/page-only and is not represented as native scheduling.
ReminderDispatchGate uses an injected scheduler port, and the desktop notification adapter uses an injected Electron Notification object; neither is Android or Windows system delivery evidence.
